story.fullStory:
The Beatles's "I Dig A Pony" — original release 1970. "Dig a Pony" is a song by the English rock band the Beatles from their 1970 album Let It Be.

It was written by John Lennon and credited to Lennon–McCartney.

The band recorded the song on 30 January 1969, during their rooftop concert at the Apple Corps building on Savile Row in central London.

Worldwide, the English rock band the Beatles have released 12 studio albums (17 in the US), 5 live albums, 52 compilation albums, 36 extended plays (EPs), and 37 box sets.
